people.name: Silas
people.line: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

translations.web: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
translations.bsb: The brothers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy remained in Berea.
translations.kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
translations.asv: And then immediately the brethren sent forth Paul to go as far as to the sea: and Silas and Timothy abode there still.
